title: v0.9.72 — Crop timers follow your cottage level

blocks.text: New crops now take longer as your cottage grows: levels 0, 1, 2 and 3 use 1×, 1.5×, 2× and 2.5× the base growing time. Mint takes 1:00, 1:30, 2:00 or 2:30. The planting preview shows the exact time before you spend a seed.

Crops already planted keep their original deadlines, even when you upgrade or reopen the game. They continue growing while the app is closed. Crop yields and costs stay the same; cooking, construction and cottage restoration still finish immediately.
新種作物現在依小屋等級延長時間：Lv.0／1／2／3 分別使用基礎時間的1／1.5／2／2.5倍。薄荷為1:00／1:30／2:00／2:30；種植前會顯示實際所需時間，再決定是否花費種子。
已種作物保留原完成時間，不因升級或重開遊戲延長；關閉程式也會繼續成長。產量與成本維持原樣，料理、建設和修屋仍為立即完成。
